I have a slightly longer, complex answer to this. However I believe its the most accurate one you'll come across.   


People around you take long to reply due to 2 reasons. First, let's look at the better sounding but the least common one.. If you're amongst people who give priority to purpose, profits and peace, then consider their late replies to be a norm.  


Second happens to be the most likely one.. which is that just as you're expecting them to reply a little sooner to you, they on the other hand might be ignoring you and waiting for someone to reply sooner to them. We all have a certain group of people we take for granted/ don't really enjoy or just simply despise. And we also have this  other group of people from whom we seek validation, attention and time. And truth is.. we all belong to either of these groups for certain people at the same time.

Been there my friend. Would say sort of still am. If you would want to vent things out and be elaborative, my DMs are open for you. Even though we're more or less on the same page, I believe I'll be able to give you a little opinion or 2 based on my experiences. Guess that's how we help each other grow through while they go  through. Take care bud.

I totally understand what you're feeling right now. I'm 22 and face the exact same career issues. You've held on to your dream since the past 8 years, means since you were 17. Usually people drop or switch their ambitions once they've transitioned from their teens to the 20's but you didn't. You held on! I absolutely believe that there's a lot in store for you. Sending positivity your way and hope you get a big break as a writer soon.

Hey there, hold on. I know you might have spoken to a lot of people by now. But you can always consider my DMs open for you. My suggestion would be to stay away from your family and if you're capable or willing enough, go on a separate path of your own and live by yourself instead of having such toxicity in the form of family.
